prompt: Why are warning signs placed significantly in advance of physical roadway hazards on Texas highways?

options.text: To increase municipal billboard revenue from roadside sign installations
To give drivers adequate time and distance to adjust speed and change lanes
To encourage drivers to accelerate quickly before the hazard appears
To test driver visual acuity during long-distance highway travel
